newsitem.title: USA: Skyline Q2 sales hurt by early winter.
newsitem.headline: Skyline Q2 sales hurt by early winter.

text.p: Skyline Corp, which produces mobile homes and recreational vehicles, on Monday said sales for the quarter to the end of November fell five percent because of the early onset of winter weather and a softening in demand for manufactured housing.
Skyline said total sales for its fiscal 1997 second quarter declined to $164.4 million from $172.5 million in the same quarter a year ago.
Sales by Skyline's manufactured housing group fell to $136.7 million from $150.1 million. Sales of recreational vehicles rose 24 percent to $27.7 million from $22.4 million.
Skyline earnings rose to $0.62 a share from $0.54 in the year earlier quarter. Fiscal 1997 second-quarter earnings included a gain of $0.06 a share from sale of an unused plant.
The New York Stock Exchange said trading in shares of Skyline was not available.
